args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) since its latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback completed successfully; service status is now rolled_out on v2.3.0.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created a **SEV2** incident for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action (on-call paged).

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with a 0.2% error rate.

Note: I did not deploy any new/unproven version, so no change-manager approval was required — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release.
